author: More Perfect Union
description: The two largest private prison companies in the United States are saying the quiet part out loud. @cohen.489 dug into their 10-K filings, which all publicly traded companies must file with the SEC. The documents reveal exactly how much money GEO Group and CoreCivic are raking in from ICE enforcement, how they're planning to boost profits, and where their vulnerabilities are.
title: We dug into GEO Group & CoreCivic's financial reports. What we found will shock you.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Ticketmaster-Live Nation has seized control of the live music industry and formed a powerful monopoly.

Donald Trump had the opportunity to break their stranglehold, and save live music.

But instead he chose to let business as usual continue.
title: How Ticketmaster Destroyed Live Music — And How Our Government Failed to Stop Them
